_comment: Env-var overlay for the production ECS task definition. Merged into containerDefinitions[0].environment / .secrets by the Deploy (production) workflow (see .github/workflows/deploy-production.yml -> 'Patch env vars from committed overlay'). Values starting with 'tf:' are resolved from `terraform output -json` at deploy time; the suffix after 'tf:' is the Terraform output name. Literal strings pass through. See docs/runbooks/prod-env-provisioning.md for the operator checklist (what to fill in by hand, when, and why).

environment._comment: DATABASE_URL is injected by the workflow's 'Resolve DB connection string' step. The RDS master secret stores {username,password} JSON, not a postgres:// URL, so the workflow assembles the URL on the runner and overrides whatever placeholder sits here. Mirror of the migrate job's logic. See the runbook.
environment.name: DATABASE_URL
